new_libraries.name: MultiControl
new_libraries.author: Andrew R. Brown
new_libraries.sentence: A unified interface for ESP32 GPIO management supporting potentiometers, buttons, switches, rotary encoders, capacitive touch, and multiplexed inputs.
new_libraries.paragraph: MultiControl provides a single-header library for reading multiple input types through a unified API. Features include potentiometer smoothing with a 7-stage pipeline, button gesture detection (click, double-click, hold, long-press), rotary encoder with acceleration, capacitive touch with noise protection, multiplexed buttons via CD4051, and a bank system for storing presets with latching behavior.
